nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): The WooCommerce explore sub-agent calls `woo_reports_top_sellers` once, retrieves the exact top-five products by ID with one `woo_products_get` call per ID, and fully paginates only `woo_customers_list` and `woo_orders_list` at `perPage=100`. Omit the optional order status field to request the unfiltered collection, aggregate every observed status locally, and return only the five product rows plus compact Shanghai/Guangzhou customer-count, order-revenue, share, page, and join controls. Do not write files or modify the store.

explore 1 (web-domain-researcher 0): The rail explore sub-agent resolves Beijing South, Shanghai Hongqiao, and Guangzhou South codes, queries both 2026-03-10 high-speed routes, and returns the exact task-configured preferred trains with display train number, route identifier where required, departure, arrival, duration, and first-class evidence. Do not write files.
